categoryCognitiveEvidence.source: function categoryCognitiveEvidence(cat){ const levels=['想起','適用','判断'].map(level=>cognitiveLevelEvidence(cat,level)); const prior=Math.round(profile.skills?.[cat]||50); const tested=levels.filter(x=>x.score!=null); const denom=levels.reduce((s,x)=>s+COGNITIVE_WEIGHTS[x.level],0); const weighted=levels.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.score==null?prior:x.score)*COGNITIVE_WEIGHTS[x.level],0); const score=tested.length?Math.round(weighted/Math.max(1,denom)):prior; const weakest=[...levels].sort((a,b)=>{ const as=a.score==null?50:a.score,bs=b.score==null?50:b.score; if(as!==bs)return as-bs; return COGNITIVE_WEIGHTS[b.level]-COGNITIVE_WEIGHTS[a.level]; })[0]; return {cat,score,levels,weakest}; }
